newsitem.title: USA: China National Textile wins $100 cp financing.
newsitem.headline: China National Textile wins $100 cp financing.

text.p: Bank of America said Monday it and Credit Suisse First Boston have arranged a $100 million U.S. commercial paper program for Chinatex Capitals Inc, a wholly-owned subsidiary of state-owned China National Textiles Import & Export Corp.
China National is the country's main channel for importing and exporting textiles.
Credit Suisse First Boston issued a letter of credit to support the commercial paper program, which is rated A1+/P1 by Standard & Poor's and Moody's Investors Service Inc, respectively.
Participants in the letter of credit facility are Credit Suisse First Boston and a consortium of 10 other banks.
Chinatex will use the proceeds from the commercial paper program, its first U.S. debt issuance, to finance its international trade business activities.
